constants.name: exchange_spread_max
constants.source: SHARP_TRACKER_BUILD_SPEC_2026-10-14.md §5; revisit at 10k events
constants.note: exchange mid enters the ruler only when ask-bid <= this; wider is logged, flagged wide, excluded

constants.name: exchange_min_depth_usd
constants.source: Sean 10/15 (Chuba Hubbard CAR@PHI, Novig -2400 bid with $2.4k vs $61 on the other side): an exchange quote enters the ruler only with at least this many resting dollars within 3c of best ON EACH SIDE; otherwise flagged thin

constants.name: exchange_outlier_pts
constants.source: Sean 10/15: a passing exchange quote more than this far (probability points) from the median of the books on the same line is flagged outlier and excluded unless 2+ other venues sit within 3 pts of it; one big make order is not a price

constants.name: exchange_outlier_confirm
constants.source: companion to exchange_outlier_pts: venues within 3 pts needed to keep an outlying exchange quote

constants.name: close_window_min
constants.source: Fable 10/14: 'close' = last tick per venue inside this many minutes before first pitch; the 20-minute job cadence means most venues have exactly one tick in the window

constants.name: horizon_tolerance_min
constants.source: Fable 10/14: the T-24h/6h/1h snapshot is the latest tick at most this old; the game-lines job has been landing irregularly (4-8 book snapshots per game instead of ~40), so 45 min would blank most snapshots; tighten to 45 once cadence is verified

constants.name: stale_book_min
constants.source: Fable 10/14: a book tick older than this at the fair timestamp is not a price; excluded from the fair

constants.name: stale_exchange_min
constants.source: Fable 10/14: same for exchange quotes (20-minute cadence + one missed run)
